project.name: Web Application Development — Task Management Platform
project.description: IT project: building a full-stack web application (frontend + API + database) for collaborative task management, from requirements gathering to production deployment.

activities.name: Requirements gathering
activities.description: Meetings with the client to identify the system's needs, goals and scope.

activities.name: Requirements analysis and specification
activities.description: Documenting functional and non-functional requirements; writing user stories.

activities.name: System architecture design
activities.description: Defining the architecture (layers, services, technology stack) and design patterns.

activities.name: Database design
activities.description: Entity-relationship model, relational schema and storage normalisation.

activities.name: UI/UX design
activities.description: Wireframes, interface prototypes and style guide. Runs in parallel with the architecture design.

activities.name: Development environment setup
activities.description: Repository, version control, basic CI/CD and the team's working environments.

activities.name: Backend development (API)
activities.description: Implementing the REST API, business logic and data access.

activities.name: Frontend development
activities.description: Implementing the user interface according to the UI/UX design.

activities.name: Frontend-backend integration
activities.description: Connecting the interface to the API and verifying the end-to-end data flow.

activities.name: Unit testing
activities.description: Automated tests for backend and frontend components. Runs in parallel with the integration.

activities.name: Integration testing
activities.description: Verifying that the integrated modules work together.

activities.name: User acceptance testing (UAT)
activities.description: Validating the system with the client against the acceptance criteria.

activities.name: Technical and user documentation
activities.description: User manuals, API documentation and deployment guide. A parallel branch after the integration.

activities.name: Production deployment
activities.description: Releasing the system to the production environment and final configuration.

activities.name: Project close
activities.description: Formal handover, retrospective and transfer to the maintenance team.
